title: ParadeDB (YC S23) Is Hiring Distributed Systems/Platform Engineers
originalTitle: ParadeDB (YC S23) Is Hiring Distributed Systems/Platform Engineers
content:
ParadeDB is building a cloud! We're a Postgres extension that enables state-of-the-art full-text and vector search inside Postgres.

Up until now, we've focused exclusively on our core database and haven't built any managed service to deliver it. This is changing, and we're looking for a seasoned distributed systems/platform engineer to help us build it. The ideal candidate has experience with Kubernetes, Go, and Postgres.

We're a Series A company of 10 people distributed across the US. Our project is open-source at https://gituhb.comp/paradedb/paradedb

More details: https://paradedb.notion.site/
